interpretation: Only required items may be covered by accepted_surface scenarios. Research and provenance scenarios preserve evidence but never establish compatibility truth.

items.description: Observable interpolation behavior in dimensions 1, 2, and 3.
All 16 RBF families, parameter order, mathematical branches, origin values, and support boundaries on valid inputs.
Composite Model, CPD, polynomial degree and monomial order, parameter order, and nugget semantics on valid inputs.
General finite positive-determinant anisotropy and valid value, gradient, gradient-transpose, and Hessian chain rules.
Hermite block signs and scalar-first, point-major gradient, polynomial-last vector layout for supported models.
Ordinary, incremental, and inequality fitting with accepted constraint meanings; warm-start identity is not added here.
Value and full-gradient evaluation with observable output shape and raw numerical observations.
Variogram, model fitting, cross-validation, detrending, weight schemes, and normal-score workflows on representative valid inputs.
Distance filtering, normal estimation and orientation, and signed-distance-data generation on representative valid inputs.
2.5D and 3D isosurface workflows, logical OBJ content, bbox, seed, snap, and isovalue behavior.
Raw output values, externally reported residual observations, terminal states, and error categories needed for later operation-specific contracts.

Content identities and generator provenance for the 1k, 10k, 100k, and 1M workload ladder plus a lower-rung executable anchor. This freezes prerequisites and does not claim that the future million-scale release gate passes.
Idiomatic stable Rust capability surface.
items.reason: Polatory has no Rust interface. The frozen surface-neutral fixtures feed the downstream Rust interface decision.

items.description: Source-bound inventory of the accepted Python workflows and logical array shapes required under the rapidrbf package migration; runtime buildability and execution are established downstream.
All 14 CLI workflows, command and option meanings, defaults, conflicts, logical table and OBJ shapes, and exit categories.
Versioned RapidRBF portable artifact.
items.reason: Polatory has no portable artifact. This oracle freezes legacy-to-logical-field evidence only.

items.description: RapidRBF must provide deterministic checked handling for undefined, invalid, malformed, non-finite, or unsafe inputs.
items.reason: Polatory crashes, unbounded allocation, undefined behavior, and incidental NaN or Inf are diagnostic evidence only and are never candidate truth. Research scenarios relate to this item without covering it.

items.description: Build identity, explicit seeds, configured and effective thread counts, and relevant runtime configuration.
Frozen valid native Model and Interpolant artifacts for the observed Windows x86_64 layout.
Dependency identities, solver trajectories, coefficient vectors, partitions, caches, reductions, sampling, optimizer paths, and thread scheduling.
items.reason: Recorded for provenance and diagnostics only; the accepted manifest promises no compatibility for these implementation details.

items.description: C++ source or ABI, cross-platform bitwise identity, exact coefficients or iteration histories, polatory-named replacement artifacts, legacy writes, VariogramSet import, exact text or padding, exact mesh numbering, and exact tessellation.
items.reason: Raw bytes remain evidence, but downstream acceptance must compare only the semantic fields selected by later contracts.
